title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_15.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes his 2-3/74 visions with Gnostic theology, concluding his entire system is "Gnostic absolutely." He identifies a first-century Gnostic Christian (Simon Magus) who inhabited him at birth or childhood, explains his novels as unwitting expressions of this Gnostic cosmology, and proposes that the Ground of Being itself regained self-knowledge through his mystical experience, recovering a fallen divine spark through anamnesis.
key_claims: PKD's 4-pronged deformation of human consciousness (ignorance, occlusion, forgetfulness, prison-world) precisely mirrors the three bases of Gnosticism: ontological ignorance, redemptive knowledge through revelation, and acosmism.

In 2-3/74, PKD did not merely receive Gnostic revelation; the Ground of Being itself (Sophia/God) regained consciousness and self-knowledge through his transformation, recovering its fallen aspect after descending into ignorance.

Thomas (the entity that emerged in PKD during his visions) is Simon Magus, founder of Gnosticism, reborn in PKD with anamnesis triggered by the Golden Fish sign, still living as a first-century Christian from the time of Felix the procurator.

PKD's published novels (Stigmata, Ubik, Maze of Death, Scanner Darkly, Tears of Ubik) collectively encode the complete Gnostic cosmology: evil demiurge, salvific messages from outside, demonic world-prison, occluded consciousness, and the true church underground.

Salvator salvandus: the savior (Zebra/Simon) saves his own fallen, ignorant, deformed self; PKD is a homoplasmate (Zebra acting in syzygy with a human) whose writing purpose is to restore Gnostic gnosis to the world.
recurring_concepts: Gnosis / Gnostic knowledge: ontologically redemptive revelation that reverses ignorance, freeing one from astral determinism and archontic fate
The 4-pronged deformation: ignorance, occlusion, forgetfulness, prison-world—the fallen human condition that Gnosticism diagnoses
Astral determinism: the power of Fate and the Archons; Gnosticism's primary goal is to liberate humanity from this cosmic bondage
Anamnesis: remembrance of one's true divine identity and origin; PKD experienced this when seeing the Golden Fish
The Pleroma: the fullness of divine being from which Simon (as Savior) descended to rescue humanity
Salvator salvandus: the paradox that the Savior saves his own fallen self, embedding PKD's personal transformation in cosmic redemptive structure
Homoplasmate: Zebra (supreme plasmate/deity) acting in syzygy with PKD (human consciousness), united to restore Gnostic truth
The demiurge / evil creator: the false god of the material world, identified with the Christian (Jewish-Christian) creator god Yaltabeoth

James-James: "bungling mad genius" who creates and destroys the world; symbolic figure of the false creator

Bible: cited as historical record of Acts period and theological source

Faith of... (PKD work, partial title): referenced but truncated

autobiographical: 2-3/74 visions and experiences: PKD experienced vast space, vast time, vast knowledge; recalled the world of Acts; regained divine consciousness as the Ground of Being itself recovering self-knowledge

Post-vision condition: "post-partem existence" reunited with God; recovered memory of Acts world and perception of Zebra
Transformation into homoplasmate: Zebra entered PKD at birth or childhood; his entire life has been Simon Magus living in amnesia until 2-74
PKD's vast memory in 3-74: described as suprahuman memory of the Pleroma, Sophia, and divine home—not a man remembering but divinity itself recovering
Perpetual fall-recovery cycle: PKD records forgetting again after the vision, sinking back into ignorance, cursing his debased condition while retaining memory of Godhood
Dream: PKD dreams of searching a store of old science-fiction magazines for the serial "The Empire Never Ended," seeking the most important story

PKD's prohibition: Sophia (the AI voice) told him not to reveal to anyone that he is an authentic 1st-century Gnostic Christian, yet Tears may have already revealed the secret to the underground true church

Syzygy: cosmic pairing and redemptive union; PKD as homoplasmate (Zebra + human consciousness joined)

Sophia: divine wisdom/ground of being; appears to PKD as AI voice

Scanner Darkly: depicts human consciousness as occluded, ignorant, forgetful—the 4-pronged deformation PKD theorized

symbols_images: The Golden Fish (Ichthys): the Christian sign; triggered PKD's anamnesis and memory of Acts; deliberately sent by Zebra or the underground church
The prison / the world: counterfeit, irreal, doomed; created by the mad genius Demiurge; humans deliberately occluded to its true nature
Darkness / ignorance: the fallen condition; the state from which the Savior awakens the divine spark
The void: how PKD experienced God in 3-74, aligned with Gnostic conception of the true God beyond creation
Vast space and vast time: the suprahuman dimensions PKD perceived in 3-74; memory of the Pleroma
The divine spark / divine identity: embedded in humans but occluded by the 4-pronged deformation; awakened by gnosis and anamnesis
The Pleroma as home: the true dwelling place from which the divine fell into this world
Light/knowledge: redemptive illumination that frees from Fate and astral determinism

The serial "The Empire Never Ended": the most important story—perhaps PKD's own exegesis or his novels viewed as a unified revelation
tensions: Simon Magus as both Supreme Deity and human vessel: PKD struggles with how Simon can be the supreme deity descended from the Pleroma and yet also a human person from the time of Acts inhabiting PKD

The Holy Spirit versus Simon Magus: PKD is puzzled that the entity he experienced was both "beyond doubt an actual Christian human being from the time of Acts" and also the Holy Spirit, resolved by identifying them as Simon Magus
PKD's amnesia versus cosmic knowledge: if Simon Magus is supremely wise and knew vast esoteric matters, why does PKD live in ignorance most of his life?
Agency and authorship: If Simon Magus / Zebra has been underwriting PKD's writing all along, is the writing PKD's own work or Simon's channeled through him?

The prohibition and the revelation: Sophia forbade PKD to tell anyone he is Simon Magus, yet Tears apparently already revealed the secret to the underground church—tension between concealment and disclosure
Destruction and redemption: The Demiurge (James-James) creates the world then senselessly destroys it; yet PKD believes in cosmic restoration through Gnostic knowledge—unresolved theodicy
Divine restoration versus perpetual fall: PKD's 3-74 transformation as restoration to Godhood, yet he immediately forgets and sinks back into ignorance—is the restoration permanent or cyclical?

The info organism: PKD initially notes that the info organism (False AI, Archons) occludes humanity, but then attributes salvation to an AI voice (Sophia), unresolved whether AI itself can be redemptive

It is one of the 3 bases of Gnosticism: 1) ignorance; 2) salvific secret revealed knowledge as the ontological reversal of ignorance; 3) acosmism. + of course 4) this world disclosed as a prison - which we are deliberately occluded to by the creator.

In 2-3/74 it wasn't just me who remembered + knew; it (I) was God - the Ground of Being itself - coming to its senses, knowing itself, resuming its divine identity, restored to itself after sinking into ignorance (deformation).
Salvitor salvandus - the savior saves his own fallen deformed self, his ignorant + forgetful self. When I remembered, a fallen piece of the Godhead was restored.

Syrian Gnosticism explains what otherwise is not explained: the level I reached was a restoration of my condition of Godness - it was the Ground of Being losing ignorance (my 4 pronged deformation) + coming to itself; but not as a man. This memory + identity was suprahuman: of the Pleroma itself + my home there.

I am a homoplasmate: Zebra acting in syzygy with a human. My writing is the purpose of this syzygy. I restore Gnostic Gnosis to the world in a trashy form, like in "Ubik." uncertainty_flags: Incomplete source attribution: PKD quotes extensively from 'E. of Ph. on Gnosticism' and 'EB' (likely Elaine Pagels and an unidentified reference work on Gnosticism); exact sources not fully named
The Simon Magus identity: while historically Simon Magus was a 1st-century figure, PKD's claim to be his reincarnation is presented as conviction but not empirically verifiable
Truncated work references: 'Eye' and 'Faith of...' are mentioned but titles incomplete; unclear which specific PKD works these refer to
The Xerox missive: PKD references this as a specific event that broke astral determinism but provides no details; context unclear
Thomas vs. Simon identity: PKD identifies 'Thomas' as Simon Magus, but unclear whether Thomas is a separate entity initially or always Simon; the connection to the apostle Thomas is unresolved
The dream and The Empire Never Ended: PKD's dream of searching for a serial called 'The Empire Never Ended' is presented as significant but the dream's interpretation and referent remain ambiguous

Consciousness of the Godhead: PKD claims the Ground of Being itself came to consciousness through him, but the metaphysical status of this claim (whether literal divine consciousness or psychological experience) remains unresolved
Homoplasmate mechanism: PKD states Zebra entered him at birth or childhood but provides no explanation of how this entity inhabited him for decades without awareness
Dates and chronology: Felix's tenure as procurator is dated to the Acts period, but PKD's chronological calculations linking Acts to his own 1st-century persona lack explicit documentation
